questions.guide: Apresente seu perfil, especialidade, experiência e o tipo de desafio que procura.
questions.sample: I'm a software engineer focused on backend systems. I have experience building APIs and working with cloud infrastructure. I enjoy solving reliability problems, and I'm looking for a remote role where I can contribute to an international team.

questions.prompt: Why are you looking for a remote role with an international company?
questions.guide: Conecte colaboração global, autonomia e impacto; evite focar somente em benefícios pessoais.
questions.sample: I enjoy working with distributed teams and communicating across time zones. I'm looking for a role where I can contribute to products used globally while continuing to grow as an engineer.

questions.guide: Pratique uma faixa em USD e deixe espaço para alinhar responsabilidades e modelo de contratação.
questions.sample: Based on the scope of the role and my experience, I'm targeting a range of X to Y per month. I'm open to discussing the full compensation package and expectations.

questions.prompt: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you handle it?
questions.guide: Mostre escuta, critérios objetivos e como a equipe chegou a uma decisão.
questions.sample: We disagreed about how to handle a database migration. I documented the risks of both approaches, asked for feedback, and proposed a small test. The results helped us choose a safer plan, and we completed the migration without downtime.

questions.prompt: Tell me about a difficult bug you fixed. How did you find it?
questions.guide: Explique impacto, investigação, causa raiz, correção e resultado mensurável.
questions.sample: A payment service had intermittent delays. I added tracing around the queue consumer, reproduced the issue, and found that retries were creating extra load. We changed the retry policy and monitored the service; processing time returned to normal.

questions.prompt: Describe a time you had to deliver under a very tight deadline.
questions.guide: Demonstre priorização, comunicação de riscos e entrega segura sem alegar que qualidade não importa.
questions.sample: We had to deliver a customer-facing fix before a release. I separated the required change from follow-up improvements, aligned the scope with the team, and added focused tests. We shipped the fix on time and scheduled the remaining work.

questions.prompt: How do you work in a remote or asynchronous team?
questions.guide: Fale sobre documentação clara, atualizações, decisões registradas e respeito a horários.
questions.sample: I write updates with context, decisions, and next steps. I document important discussions and flag blockers early, so teammates can continue without waiting for a meeting.

questions.prompt: Tell me about a time you had to learn a new technology quickly.
questions.guide: Mostre como delimitou o problema, estudou o necessário e validou o aprendizado na prática.
questions.sample: I needed to work with a service I had not used before. I started with the official documentation, built a small proof of concept, and asked a teammate to review my design. I was able to deliver the feature and share the notes with the team.

questions.prompt: Explain how async/await works under the hood in C#.
questions.guide: Explique state machine, operações de I/O e por que async não significa criar uma thread para tudo.
questions.sample: The compiler transforms an async method into a state machine. When it awaits an incomplete task, the method yields and resumes when the operation completes. For I/O-bound work, this avoids blocking a thread while the operation is in progress.

questions.prompt: What causes an N+1 query problem in EF Core, and how do you fix it?
questions.guide: Descreva consultas repetidas, como detectar o padrão e opções como projeção ou carregamento explícito.
questions.sample: The problem happens when loading a collection triggers an additional query for each item. I inspect the generated SQL and query count, then use a projection or an intentional include when appropriate. I also verify that the result size stays reasonable.

questions.prompt: When would you use threads vs processes vs asyncio in Python?
questions.guide: Compare I/O-bound e CPU-bound, custo de processos e compatibilidade das bibliotecas.
questions.sample: For I/O-bound tasks, threads or asyncio can improve concurrency, depending on the libraries involved. For CPU-bound work, processes can use multiple cores. I choose based on the workload and the complexity we can support.

questions.prompt: What's the difference between SQS, SNS, and EventBridge?
questions.guide: Compare fila, publicação para múltiplos assinantes e roteamento de eventos por regras.
questions.sample: SQS is a queue that decouples producers and consumers. SNS distributes messages to multiple subscribers. EventBridge routes events based on rules and event patterns. I choose based on delivery, fan-out, and routing requirements.

questions.prompt: How do you manage Terraform state and avoid drift across environments?
questions.guide: Mencione estado remoto, locking, revisão de plano e mudanças controladas.
questions.sample: I use a shared remote backend with locking and restricted access. Changes go through code review and a reviewed plan, and I run plans regularly to detect drift before applying changes.

questions.guide: Comece por requisitos e escala antes de escolher banco, cache ou estratégia de IDs.
questions.framework: Requirements → estimates → API → data → architecture → trade-offs
questions.sample: I would clarify expected traffic, link lifetime, and analytics requirements first. Then I would define create and redirect APIs, choose a unique ID strategy, store the mapping, and add caching for popular links.

questions.prompt: Design a rate limiter for a public API.
questions.guide: Discuta identidade do cliente, algoritmo, armazenamento distribuído e comportamento em falha.
questions.sample: I would clarify whether limits are per user, API key, or IP. A token bucket can allow short bursts while enforcing an average rate. For multiple API instances, the counters need shared state or a gateway-level implementation.

questions.prompt: Given an array of integers, find two numbers that add up to a target.
questions.guide: Pense em voz alta: esclareça restrições, proponha abordagem, explique Big-O e teste um exemplo.
questions.framework: Restate → clarify → approach + Big-O → code → test
questions.sample: I would clarify whether there can be duplicate values and whether the same element can be used twice. A hash map lets me check the complement in constant average time, so the time complexity is O(n).

questions.prompt: What are indexes, and how do they speed up queries?
questions.guide: Explique custo de escrita/armazenamento, seletividade e como validar com plano de execução.
questions.framework: How it works → benefit → cost → validation
questions.sample: An index helps the database find rows without scanning the whole table. It can improve reads, but it uses storage and adds work to writes. I check the query plan and workload before adding one.

questions.prompt: What questions do you have for us?
questions.guide: Faça perguntas sobre sucesso inicial, colaboração, decisões técnicas, fuso horário e processo de entrega.
questions.sample: What would success look like in the first 90 days? How does the team handle asynchronous decisions and code reviews?

questions.prompt: How do you ask an interviewer to repeat or clarify a question?
questions.guide: Treine frases de sobrevivência para ganhar tempo sem perder confiança.
questions.sample: Sorry, could you repeat that a bit slower? Just to make sure I understood, are you asking about…?
